subject: Recap + MAP for ACME evaluation / confirm owners & dates

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + MAP (Mutual Action Plan) for ACME evaluation

Hi Jordan 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Primary use case: cost-aware customer support summarization + internal knowledge retrieval for tier 2.
- Success criteria: reduce avg handle time by 15% and keep hallucination rate under 2% on eval prompts.
- Initial scope: proof-of-concept across 2 teams (support + ops), ~100k monthly tokens.

Next steps I mentioned on the call:
1) I attached a Mutual Action Plan (ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx) with proposed owners and target dates.
2) Rishi will share a short integration checklist for SSO and data flow.
3) We align on evaluation owners and a 4-week pilot window.

Can you confirm the ACME owners for the evaluation (technical lead and product owner) and whether the target start date of 2027-06-07 works? If that date is tight, tell me what would be realistic and we can adjust the MAP.

Attachment: ACME_MAP_v1.xlsx (Mutual Action Plan, owners & timeline)

Thanks  looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
